issues.summary: The photographed wall-and-spike segment is not reliably passable by the human player.
issues.expected: The main route visibly offers a comfortable path with time for one observation and corrective tap, and a real player can pass it without knowing hidden coordinates.
issues.actual: A tall wall and floating spike leave a narrow, misleading passage; the user repeatedly cannot pass.

issues.summary: Rebound is incorrectly expressed as a dedicated pink recoil object instead of ordinary rigid-body back-side contact.
issues.expected: Any ordinary hard surface reflects body or handle contact from relative incident velocity and contact normal, like a thrown object hitting terrain; no dedicated rebound object exists.
issues.actual: The course contains a recoil-identified pink wall with an arrow and special collision behavior.

completionRule: Both issues require red-first tests, a passing build, and an independent Reviewer completing the full course with real mouse and native touch without loadScenario or debug mutation.
